\chapter{IAM in bits}
\label{ch:bits}

\textbf{IAM is a model of how reality begins with a bit and the cost that comes with it.} This chapter is the connections table: one
computer term per row, and in each of the four applications the word that application uses for it, with the status this book gives it.
The same table, with every value and its source, is \texttt{development/bit\_paper/BIT\_TABLES.md}; the four-domain schematic it is drawn
from is \texttt{FOUR\_DOMAINS.md}. \emph{Open} means no value has been found yet.

\section*{Price per bit}
\emph{the least energy to write one bit at this surface (Landauer, at the surface's temperature).}
\begin{description}
\item[Cosmos] the epoch-dependent cost (cost per bit at the horizon) \hfill(\textit{conjecture})
\item[Qubits] the Landauer cost per bit (at 15 mK); 'k\_BT ln2 per bit at the temperature each record actually sees' \hfill(\textit{conjecture})
\item[Chips] Landauer floor for logic ('The Landauer floor') \hfill(\textit{calculated})
\item[Cells: IAM-A (molecules)] Landauer cost per mark \hfill(\textit{derived})
\item[Cells: Met-A (arrays)] Landauer cost per mark \hfill(\textit{derived})
\end{description}
